tenderSchedule.title: Re-Tender for Outsourcing of management and disposal of Biomedical waste generated in CIMS teaching hospitals, Chamarajanagar
tenderSchedule.description:
Re-Tender for Outsourcing of management and
disposal of Biomedical waste generated in
CIMS teaching hospitals, Chamarajanagar
tenderSchedule.locationName: Chamarajanagar Institute of Medical Sciences Chamarajanagar

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions mentioned in the bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Work order copies and Satisfactory working certificate from any three govt / private hospitals in last 3 years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.
Pan or Tan No, Income tax returns statement of last 3 financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.
GST registration certificate to be submitted and Apr 26 to Jul 26 GST-R-3B copies should be submitted
Professional tax registration certificate and clearance certificate of financial year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.
Annual turnover Statement, Profit loss account and Balance Sheet of 3 years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25
Signed and Notarized Bid Document should be submitted
EMD Payment receipt should be submitted
Notarized Self declaration on Rs 100 stamp paper stating that the firm is not black listed and abide all rules of labour act and PCB as per annexure-II
List of equipment or vehicles available for bio-medical waste management, shifting of same from hospital to waste management unit
License copy for biomedical waste disposal given by the competent authority
